summary: Invalid credentials error renders in the top banner instead of inline under the password field
description: On a failed email/password login the error message appears in the generic top-of-form banner. PRD FR-03 requires the error to render inline beneath the offending field and to be announced via an assertive live region. The banner path is the fallback and should only be used for non-field errors such as network failure.
steps_to_reproduce: Enter a valid email for an existing account
expected_result: Inline error 'Email or password is incorrect' under the password field, announced assertively
actual_result: Top-of-form banner shows the message; no inline error; screen reader announces nothing

comments.author: sam.okafor
comments.body: Root cause is in the login view: the catch block routes every 401 to the banner handler before the reason-code map is consulted. Fix is to key the banner off `reason` and default unknown reasons to the banner only.

comments.author: dana.whitfield
comments.body: Adding a regression assertion that the banner element is empty for invalid_credentials. Fails on 1421, should pass once the map is used.
